title: Actions upon reception of SIB19
text: Upon receiving SIB19,   the UE shall:
1 >  instruct the lower layers to start  or  restart ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration from the subframe indicated by epochTime;
NOTE: UE should attempt to re-acquire SIB19 before the end of the duration indicated by ntn- UlSyncValidityDuration and epochTime by UE implementation.
